In [[mathematics]], the '''Herglotz–Zagier function''',{{sfnp|Masri|2004}} named after [[Gustav Herglotz]] and [[Don Zagier]],{{sfnp|Herglotz|1923}} is the function

:<math>F(x)= \sum^{\infty}_{n=1} \left\{\frac{\Gamma^{\prime}(nx)}{\Gamma (nx)} -\log (nx)\right\} \frac{1}{n}.</math>

It was introduced by Zagier who used it to obtain a [[Kronecker limit formula]] for [[real quadratic field]]s.{{sfnp|Zagier|1975}}
